instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Keep what I know about a prospect as one row of my prospect list: what a finder found, the researched profile, a status I move it through, and my notes", and give it nothing more: every input is optional.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:keep-a-prospect and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: One row per prospect, under the key you give; keeping it again writes over the same row and leaves the fields you keep by hand.
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: record:prospects (records:read, records:list, records:write).
